body:
**Parent epic:** #278

**Depends on:** #279 (SOURCE_REUSE_LEDGER)

## Outcome
Full O1 circuit/net/Ref-pin ownership and interface contract for separate front jack PCB, separate pot/control PCB, octave assembly, local middle zone and rear OSC card.

## Deliverables
- Assign every existing net, component/unit/package and endpoint to an owner, including protection, buffering, local returns, decoupling and shared services. Preserve 4 inputs, 4 outputs, all 8 controls and 6 trimmers. Maintain raw-jack protection and output driver feedback locally at the jack PCB.
- Prohibit timing capacitor, exponential summing, compensation/high-frequency correction, VEE5 feedback and unshaped internal waveform nodes from generic middle-board/harness interfaces. Classify each control wiper/conditioned signal by source impedance, loading and allowed length/capacitance rather than assuming buffering.
- Inventory **existing rear terminals first**: exact identity, function, net/pin, protection, owning circuit, support/load path and required connection/service access. Retain existing power/interface terminals; identify any unknowns from source. Additional performance I/O or duplicate outputs are not implied. If proposed, state purpose, protection, loading and patch behavior separately for owner decision.
- Reconcile all current O1 11 harnesses/51 conductors (AGND included): each connection is retained short, replaced by middle traces, internalized, or newly required. Count both middle-board faces, contacts/crimps, services and test adapters; do not infer savings by subtracting service-net count.
- Shared starting services: +12 V, -12 V, +5 V, AGND, OSC_REF5, OSC_REFN5, OSC_GATE_REF and OSC_OCT0–OSC_OCT5. These are 13 net classes, **not a 13-pin connector specification**. Define additional return/contact needs, keying, mating orientation and partial-power exposure as proposals.
- Compare full functional architecture and core-only-card control with the same endpoints; identify which shared packages force front-board redesign. Produce an explicit mapping for O1→O2→O5, retaining identity and polarity.

## Acceptance
Zero unexplained/missing/duplicate endpoints or package units; every crossing has a net class, direction, owner and local return/protection rationale. Unknown connector MPN/pin assignments remain open proposals. Independent circuit review signs off the mapping, not electrical suitability.

## Execution boundary
Planning deliverable under #278; **not started by issue creation**. Read #278, AGENTS.md and circuit/WORKFLOW.md before later authorized work. No production source/CAD changes, native campaigns, merge, fabrication, ordering or energization under the organization request. Preserve five OSC/all 33 functions/438 centres, canonical boards, decision.json and KEEP_K1402_INCUMBENT. Use exact source hashes and distinguish proposal, source/model evidence, native evidence and bench evidence. Missing checks are NOT RUN. Do not restart parked #242/E16 prompts or reopen completed finite-path/552-omission tasks. Keep pre-existing electrical and physical defects open.
title: [Design][02] Map complete O1 interfaces and existing rear terminals
